Long Haul

Contrato de vigilância dependente

A prearranged automatic reporting agreement (ADS-C) between ATC and aircraft for position, intent, and status data in remote or oceanic airspace.

Definition

A prearranged automatic reporting agreement (ADS-C) between ATC and aircraft for position, intent, and status data in remote or oceanic airspace.

Operational example

Auckland Control, QFA146 reports ADS-C contract established, position and intent data being sent automatically every ten minutes.

Localized term

Contrato de vigilância dependente

Localized example

Controle Auckland, QFA146 informa contrato ADS-C estabelecido, dados de posição e intenção enviados automaticamente a cada dez minutos.
